summary: Tested read receipts feature: Backend sets read_at timestamp when messages are marked as read. Frontend shows CheckCheck icon (double checkmark) for read messages, Check icon (single checkmark) for delivered. Admin has toggle (eye/eye-off) to enable/disable showing read receipts. Toggle state stored in localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read receipts feature fully tested. Backend tests verify: read_at timestamp set when employee reads admin messages, read_at timestamp set when admin reads employee/consignor messages, ISO timestamp format. Frontend tests verify: read receipts toggle visible in conversation header, toggle shows eye/eye-off icon, toggle state persists in localStorage, admin messages show checkmarks (Check for delivered, CheckCheck for read), employee messages show checkmarks when read by admin.

read_receipts_toggle.details: Eye/eye-off toggle in conversation header, persists state in localStorage

read_at_timestamp_backend.details: Backend sets read_at timestamp when messages are marked as read via GET endpoints

admin_checkmarks.details: Admin messages show Check (delivered) or CheckCheck (read) icons when read receipts enabled

employee_checkmarks.details: Employee messages show Check (delivered) or CheckCheck (read) icons

toggle_disable_hides_checkmarks.details: When read receipts disabled, checkmarks are hidden from admin view
